question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the same as are the numbers in the given set.

(9, 81, 6561)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² = 2nd number, (2nd number)² = 3rd number.

Now,

For (9, 81, 6561):

⇒ (9)² = 81 and (81)² = 6561.

Simila
